change: Revenue rose. Profit also benefited when Bosch reversed money it had set aside for employee long-service awards. The filing restates the same quarter last year to include Bosch Chassis Systems.
watch: Check how much profit comes from vehicle parts before counting gains that come from reversing old expenses.

sources.label: Bosch’s exchange filing
sources.location: Consolidated financial results, September quarter columns, rows 1(a), 4 and 9. Notes 5(b) and 5(c) describe the award reversal and accounting for the chassis systems purchase.
